periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation; the primary axes of the patches slant inward toward the rostrum at approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High aspect ratio; the patches exhibit an elongated oval morphology with a vertical length approximately 2.2 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced; the teardrop-like morphology shows a significant downward extension where the lowest point is situated well below the geometric center of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear gap is wide, measuring approximately 1.8 times the horizontal width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth and convex; the superior boundaries of the ears describe a continuous semi-circular arc with no observable flattening.
